parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the route propagation.

- **Active**: The propagation is active.

- **Enabling**: The propagation is being enabled.

- **Disabling**: The propagation is being disabled.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance.

- **VPC**: a virtual private cloud (VPC).

- **VBR**: a virtual border router (VBR).

- **TR**: a transit router.

- **VPN**: a VPN connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table of the Enterprise Edition transit router.
